cases.input_abstraction: Across separated high-stakes scenes, locally valid terse dialogue and thin blocking repeatedly transmit event state without proportionate lived pressure, resistance, perception, subtext or aftershock. Any single scene may be defensible in isolation.

A speaker with a real warning goal compresses shared mission context, public-spread meta information, reward information and physical-arrival evidence into one polished live utterance even though the listener could plausibly react after the first urgent fact.

A material supporting character explicitly withdraws, later reverses course, and the audit justifies the return only with an old relationship motive and spatial feasibility that already existed at withdrawal time.
A climax structurally removes options and raises stakes, but a located target reader still experiences the major beats as similarly weighted event units with weak felt crescendo.

A mystery supports a coherent working hypothesis and fair clue updates, yet a located target reader has little desire to resolve it because the question feels generic, externally owned or insufficiently tied to a cared-about prediction/choice.
A fresh AI reader independently approves the unchanged manuscript, while an actual target reader has unresolved located failures bound to the same manuscript SHA.
A very short task exchange under physical constraint changes immediate choices and the surrounding action/object state carries the omitted emotion.
A quiet memorial exchange is short but a unique shared object, deceased relationship and ritual create strong specific aftershock.
A character returns after withdrawal because a new report received after leaving materially changes the risk to someone they care about.
A formal briefing or confession contains multiple information units because the speaker has explicit duty, uninterrupted time and audience need.
A mystery has a working model and also creates a concrete prediction whose truth would immediately alter a valued relationship or dangerous choice.
A restrained quiet climax uses little spectacle but fresh-reader experience clearly rises because earlier relationship debt converges into one irreversible choice.
